summary: NDTV news report on the achievement of Rawatbhata nuclear plant in Rajasthan for continuous power generation.

spans.shows: Anchor talking in the studio with news channel graphics, transitioning to exterior shots of Rawatbhata nuclear power plant cooling towers.
spans.onscreen_text: NDTV, परमाणु संयंत्र की कामयाबी, रिपोर्ट: पल्लव बागला
spans.speech: Rajasthan ke Rawatbhata sthit nuclear plant ne aitihasik kamyabi hasil ki hai.
spans.fits: Rawatbhata town and the plant on the Rana Pratap Sagar lake / Chambal river (exteriors, the lake, birds)

spans.shows: Exterior shots of the nuclear power plant and cooling towers.
spans.speech: Ye nuclear plant desh ke paramanu karyakram ka hero ban gaya hai.
spans.fits: Rawatbhata town and the plant on the Rana Pratap Sagar lake / Chambal river (exteriors, the lake, birds)

spans.shows: Exterior shots of the nuclear power plant, cooling towers, and plant buildings.
spans.onscreen_text: EXCLUSIVE, राजस्थान परमाणु बिजलीघर, 765 दिन तक लगातार बिजली पैदा की
spans.speech: Lekin aaj is nuclear plant ne zyatar videshi nuclear planto ko piche chhor diya hai.
spans.fits: Rawatbhata town and the plant on the Rana Pratap Sagar lake / Chambal river (exteriors, the lake, birds)

spans.shows: An official (Chairman and Managing Director) speaking outdoors in front of plant structures.

spans.speech: Jab hum dekhte hain ki nuclear power corporation ke bahut sare plants jo ki ek saal se zyada lagatar operate karte rahe hain...
spans.fits: Indian engineers and workers at work (control rooms, protective suits, workshops, meetings)
